li.label: terrible broadcast
li.description: The broadcast was awful, the speech giver rambled and stuttered, we had an opportunity to let everyone know of our achievements and we wasted it.

li.label: boring broadcast
li.description: The broadcast was... boring, it was partly there but lacked something fundamental. The speech giver took way too long to get to the point, what a shame.

li.label: satisfying broadcast
li.description: That was a good broadcast, the speech giver hit the right points at the right time, we should schedule another one soon.

li.label: spectacular broadcast
li.description: The broadcast was amazing! The speech giver showcased everything great about our community, and more importantly, our ideals. It will surely bring us positive attention.
